candidates.rationale: This statement reads a size field from potentially untrusted disk data without validation. If the size value is maliciously crafted, it can lead to integer overflow or buffer overflow when used in subsequent pointer arithmetic and memory operations.

This statement performs pointer arithmetic using the unvalidated 'esize' value. Without proper bounds checking, this can result in out-of-bounds pointer calculation leading to memory corruption or arbitrary memory access.

This memory operation uses calculated pointers that may be out of bounds due to unvalidated size values. Can cause buffer overflow or use-after-free if the offset calculation exceeds allocated memory boundaries.
